page.layout: One page of text, main column centre-right; running head at top; faint show-through text in the right margin (not transcribed). Digitiser caption at the foot is excluded.

main_text.p: tum propriis impendiis, tum aliorum, ut necesse est fieri, conductis operis sumptuosa; Hoc admiculo destituti nostrates Philosophi, risum non teneas, ita suspicantur & hariolantur variè: Et tandem id statuunt plerumque, quod speciosum, quod Mundi harmoniam ornatumque commendet: Salvete ô bene meriti de Natura rerum Errones: Quin ridiculo isto, quo nitimini principio, Philosophos omnes divites asseritis? Et, ut video, assereretis profecto, nisi Sensus tam vivaci ferulâ doceret contrarium.

Contrà. Esset doctorum hominum nimis invidenda felicitas; & aliorum deplorata calamitas, si illos & Opes erigerent & Scientiæ; hos Paupertas deprimeret & Insci-tia: Cur cum tantis montibus voragines tantæ? Nimias illas asperitates

page.notes: Printed text is in one column; the first line is partly cut at the right edge ("tum alio-" hyphenated across into "rum"). Line ending "tates" is at the right edge and may be partly obscured. Show-through from the facing page in the right margin is not transcribed.
